test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fa6c105fd567a2f7e7d9243c6f563cf502f5a446cc3ee9f4181a8b8e875dee1.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/956e39dc8c1858b5672092de1ec866a815b90929f37e3a85a000b45f8244bc90.png] 

1) Second figure is the mirror image of first figure.

2) Third figure is the water image of second figure.

3) Fourth figure is the mirror image of third figure.

4) Fifth figure is the water image of fourth figure.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
